meaning: rag, torn pieces of garment or fabric

elsewhere.note: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.
Elisha saw it, and he cried, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!” He saw him no more. Then he took hold of his own clothes, and…
for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
